einzeiler: Collection of true personal horror and stalking encounters.
kurzfassung: This episode presents several real-life accounts of unsettling encounters and stalking. Listeners hear stories involving landlords, strange neighbors, and attempted break-ins. Additional accounts feature individuals targeted by stalkers or discovering they were watched.
stichpunkte: A landlord secretly watching a tenant for a year
An encounter involving a strange crime scene fanboy
A stalker observed in a backyard
An instance of being unknowingly stalked for years
Reflections on a potentially dangerous situation
